desc: Cinnamon Chex Cereal is a sweetened rice-based cereal known for its signature crunchy texture and warm cinnamon flavor. Each piece is shaped into a crisp lattice square and coated with real cinnamon and sugar. It’s a gluten-free cereal with no artificial colors, no artificial flavors, and no high-fructose corn syrup, making it a wholesome option for breakfast or snacking. Fortified with 12 essential vitamins and minerals, including iron and B vitamins, it provides a balance of taste and nutrition in every bowl. Ideal for cereal lovers of all ages, it's also great for recipes like snack mixes and no-bake treats.
features:
Features:

Made with real cinnamon for a sweet, warm flavor.

Gluten-free cereal – suitable for those with gluten sensitivities.

Contains whole grain rice as the first ingredient.

No high-fructose corn syrup.

No artificial colors or flavors.

Provides 12 essential vitamins and minerals.

Light, crispy texture – ideal for snacking or breakfast

Kosher certified.

Contains about 13 grams of whole grain per serving.

Low in fat with 0g trans fat and 0g saturated fat.

Benefits:

A delicious and family-friendly option for a quick, nutritious breakfast.

Great for individuals following a gluten-free diet.

Offers a source of energy with balanced carbohydrates.

Supports overall wellness with added iron, calcium, and B-vitamins.

Makes a great base for homemade snack mixes or recipes.

Naturally crunchy and satisfying, with just the right amount of sweetness.

Helps maintain a clean diet thanks to its simple ingredient list.
ingredients: Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Cinnamon, Molasses, Rosemary Extract, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
